shortDescription: Resource module for Endpoint Analytics Profiling-Rules

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: clusterId
options.description: Unique identifier for ML cluster. Only applicable for 'ML Rule'.

options.name: conditionGroups
options.description: Endpoint Analytics Profiling Rules's conditionGroups.

options.name: isDeleted
options.description: Flag to indicate whether the rule was deleted.

options.name: lastModifiedBy
options.description: User that last modified the rule. It is read-only, and is ignored if provided as part of input request.

options.name: lastModifiedOn
options.description: Timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) of last modification. It is read-only, and is ignored if provided as part of input request.

options.name: pluginId
options.description: Plugin for the rule. Only applicable for 'Cisco Default' rules.

options.name: rejected
options.description: Flag to indicate whether rule has been rejected by user or not. Only applicable for 'ML Rule'.

options.name: result
options.description: Endpoint Analytics Profiling Rules's result.

options.name: ruleId
options.description: Unique identifier for the rule. This is normally generated by the system, and client does not need to provide it for rules that need to be newly created.

options.name: ruleName
options.description: Human readable name for the rule.

options.name: rulePriority
options.description: Priority for the rule.

options.name: ruleType
options.description: Type of the rule.

options.name: ruleVersion
options.description: Version of the rule.

options.name: sourcePriority
options.description: Source priority for the rule.

options.name: usedAttributes
options.description: List of attributes used in the rule. Only applicable for 'Cisco Default' rules.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
